_readme: Monitoring configuration for the sensor-based water quality indicator. Every value here is configurable. Reference ranges are DEFAULTS taken from commonly cited drinking-water aesthetic/operational references; they are NOT Qatari regulatory limits and have NOT been confirmed by any authority. Set 'confirmed' to true only after the responsible institution has approved them. A null range means 'no threshold configured': that parameter is displayed but not classified.

operations._readme: freshnessMinutes: a reading older than this is stale and excluded from the current network summary; a device whose newest reading is older is shown as offline (set it to a few multiples of the devices' real reporting interval). deviceLookbackHours: devices with no reading in this window are not listed at all.

validity._readme: Physical plausibility filters (not quality thresholds). A value outside these bounds is treated as a sensor fault and ignored, never as zero.

ph.label: pH
ph.source: Default reference range 6.5-8.5: US EPA National Secondary Drinking Water Regulations (aesthetic) and the range commonly cited by WHO for operational control. WHO sets no health-based guideline value for pH. neutralBand is a display convention for the Acidic / Neutral / Alkaline label only.

temperature.label: Water temperature
temperature.source: No universal threshold exists. Configure a site-specific or operational range here.

tds_ppm.label: Total dissolved solids
tds_ppm.source: Default upper reference 1000 mg/L (~ppm): WHO background document on TDS in drinking-water (taste acceptability; no health-based guideline value). US EPA secondary standard is stricter (500 mg/L). Replace with the limit that applies to the intended use of each well.

turbidity_raw.label: Turbidity
turbidity_raw.source: The database holds raw sensor counts and voltage only. No validated NTU conversion exists, so turbidity is displayed raw, is never labelled NTU and never contributes to the assessment.

deviation.method: Modified z-score of the current network median against the median of earlier time buckets in the selected period (Iglewicz & Hoaglin, 1993)
